meta.name: FigureQuiz · Field Guide
meta.description: Light graph-paper study app: ink-navy type, highlighter-yellow emphasis, and paper-tag labels that students write their answers into in a handwritten face.
source_references: Design canvas https://claude.ai/artifact/XkzkRL8C9Vg2G6qWTDci3Q: direction B on the Directions page and every board on the Screens page
Tokens copied from the mockups' source, not measured from screenshots

primary.role: Ink: text, every border, primary buttons

secondary.role: Muted ink: secondary text, nav links, captions

accent.role: Highlighter: emphasis swipes, number badges, correct answers, the hover offset on primary buttons

neutral.usage: #FCFCFA page ground under a 24px graph grid (rgba(37,72,160,.075) lines); #FFFFFF cards; #F6F8FD panels and empty thumbnails; #EEF1F7 progress tracks; #E2E6EF table column rules; #C9D0E0 dashed dividers; #9AA1B5 empty-state text; #6B7390 placeholders; #4F5872 secondary text; #1A2238 text and borders

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-light dominant: ink #1A2238 on white or #FCFCFA. Yellow is only ever a fill behind ink text, never a text colour. Error text uses #C2381B or #A12E14 (with #FFE7E0 tints) and success text #14613E on #E3F5EC, all above 4.5:1.

font_families.heading: Bricolage Grotesque (500, 700, 800)
font_families.mono: None. The third face is Caveat (500 to 700), used where a student would write by hand: typed answers, margin notes and step numerals

typography.font_style_notes: Characterful grotesk headlines with tight tracking over a neutral sans for the interface. Caveat appears only for handwriting moments, at 21px or more, and never for paragraphs. Overlines are uppercase.

spacing.section_rhythm: Landing sections sit 112px apart. App screens use 28 to 36px between blocks. Cards are padded 20 to 32px.

layout.grid_system: Flex-wrap rows with basis widths, plus auto-fit grids of repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(270px to 340px, 100%), 1fr))
layout.columns: Two on desktop (content 2.4 to sidebar 1, or text 1 to figure 1.6); one on a phone
layout.gutter: 24px to 28px (56px between hero text and figure)

shape.border_usage: Bold borders: 1.5px ink on every card, input, tag and outlined button; a 2px dashed ink border on the drop zone

levels.high: 4px 4px 0 #1A2238 for a focused tag; cards lift to 10px 12px 0 rgba(26,34,56,.12) on hover

elevation.depth_cues: Offset hard shadows and slight rotation, like paper laid on a desk

iconography.style: Outline line icons with round caps and joins
iconography.preferred_set: Custom inline SVG in this stroke style; Lucide matches if a set is needed

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) for entrances; cubic-bezier(.3,1.4,.5,1) spring for tags, hovers and focus; cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1) for highlighter sweeps
motion.entrance_pattern: Fade up 14px with a 60 to 80ms stagger. Label tags drop in, rotating from -7 degrees, 80ms apart. The phone answer sheet slides up from below.
motion.exit_pattern: None in the mockups; route changes should cross-fade
motion.philosophy: playful bouncy, but functional first: every animation marks a change of state (focus, right, wrong, unlocked, processing)

components.button_style: Primary: ink pill (#1A2238, white text, 44 to 50px tall) that lifts on hover over a 4px yellow offset shadow. Secondary: white pill with a 1.5px ink outline that fills #FFF6C7 on hover. Tertiary: text link on a 7px highlighter underline that floods on hover.
components.input_style: Form fields: 1.5px ink border, 12px radius, white, 50px tall; focus adds a 4px #FFE15A ring. Answer fields are paper tags: #FFFDF2, 5px radius, a slight tilt that straightens on focus, Caveat 21 to 30px, and a yellow numbered badge sitting on the left edge.
components.card_style: White, 1.5px ink border, 12px radius, 8px hard offset shadow at 8% ink. Hover lifts 2 to 4px. A featured card gets a strip of yellow tape across its top edge.
components.navigation_pattern: White top bar with an ink bottom border and pill tabs (active: #FFF6C7 fill with an ink outline). Study mode swaps the tabs for a back link, a 17-segment progress bar and an exit button.
components.modal_style: Bottom sheet on phones: 22px top radius, ink top border, slides up. No centred modals yet.
components.list_style: Rows split by 1.5px dashed dividers: icon tile, two lines of text, a status chip on the right
components.component_notes: Type-on labels are inputs positioned in percentages over the extracted label boxes, each box padded by 1% of the width and 1.2% of the height so it covers the drawn blank and its number. Below roughly 600px they become tappable pins with one docked answer field and previous and next buttons. The source slide stays blurred and locked until the question is checked.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A field notebook on graph paper: highlighter, paper tags and handwritten answers
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary indie editorial with analogue stationery cues

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous around the figure and between landing sections
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Ink borders anchor every block; yellow pulls the eye to the one thing that matters on each screen
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element: the diagram with its labels
visual_language.texture_usage: A 24px graph grid behind everything; tape strips and tilt on paper elements

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy plus highlighter colour weight
composition.flow_direction: Text on the left leads to the interactive figure on the right; top-down in the app
composition.grouping_strategy: Bordered cards with dashed internal dividers
composition.negative_space_role: Lets the diagram breathe and separates landing sections

imagery.photo_treatment: No photography. Real slide renders are shown untouched inside ink-bordered frames.
imagery.illustration_style: Small outline line drawings with one coral accent stroke
imagery.image_shape: Rounded rectangles (6px to 8px) with 1.5px ink borders

interaction_feel.feedback_style: A right answer gets a yellow highlighter sweep and a hand-drawn green tick. A wrong one shakes and gets a coral wavy underline; in tables the correct answer is written underneath in handwriting.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Lift with an offset shadow; links flood with highlighter
interaction_feel.loading_style: A yellow shimmer over the deck thumbnail plus a three-step checklist: Uploaded, Reading the slides, Writing questions

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: A handwritten nudge plus one action, e.g. "drag it here, or Choose a file"
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Specific and actionable: says what failed and what still worked, e.g. "Couldn’t read page 4. It looks like a scan of a printout."

overview.fallback_strategy: prefers-reduced-motion turns every animation and transition off and shows final states

background_effects.description: A static graph-paper grid drawn with two linear gradients; nothing moves

text_effects.description: A highlighter swipe sweeps in behind the last words of each hero headline

params.animation_per_unit: Background grows from 0% to 100% width over 800ms
params.effect_style: marker highlight from 56% to 92% of the line height

image_effects.description: The source slide is blurred and locked until the question is checked, then sharpens into view

params.reveal_animation: 700ms unblur while scaling from 1.08 to 1, with the lock overlay fading out

svg_animations.description: The hand-drawn arrow on the landing page and the green answer ticks draw themselves

params.stroke_animation: Arrow: a 220-unit dash over 1.1s after a 1.1s delay. Tick: a 26-unit dash over 0.5s after a 0.2s delay.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Everything is CSS: no canvas, WebGL or animation library, so it costs almost nothing on a school laptop. The two signature moments are the highlighter sweep (headlines, correct answers) and the tag drop-in (labels landing on the diagram). Keep yellow behind ink only. On phones the label inputs become pins plus a docked answer sheet, because at 375px each label box on the diagram is under 20px tall.
